baseline.task2625_estimate_scope_caveat: task2625/freeze_study.py records root_pool_preparation_observed_seconds and full_source_audit_observed_seconds but expected_seconds sums only training_projection_seconds + evaluation_projection_seconds + preparation_and_audit_hard_reserve_seconds; this planning note does not copy that omission into the final rule1 estimate.

break_even.final_gate: Use the full measured/projected total before registration. If it is >=7200 seconds, request explicit Chat mailbox necessity assessment before registration/launch.
break_even.interpretation: If the cost probe reaches less than the break-even node count by 180s, conservatively project >=120 minutes and request Chat mailbox necessity assessment before any registration. If at/above, compute a source-matched full estimate including measured prep, audit, training and evaluation; this screening threshold alone does not authorize registration.
break_even.threshold_scope: Preliminary lower-bound screen only. The 42,965-node / 239 nodes/s figure assumes zero measured rule1 preparation, root audit and feasibility cost, so it is not the final budget gate.

limitations: The task2625 reserve is reused as a conservative fixed allowance, not a calibrated rule1 overhead distribution.
The one-rule eval size is a quarter-scale planning assumption; use the exact frozen per-rule/seed/endpoint slot matrix before registration.
Rules-1 search speed may vary by trajectory; an 80k scan is a cost feasibility signal, not a runtime guarantee.
No training, outcomes, model comparison or registration is created by this note.
The preliminary break-even omits actual root preparation/audit/feasibility time; it must be recomputed using their receipts before any registration or launch.

prospective_scale_assumption.evaluation_scale: one quarter of task2625 total slots/nodes; candidate-specific cost scan replaces the same-rate assumption

question: What outcome-blind 80k-node rule1 feasibility rate would make the one-rule four-seed 1M-train-node plus quarter-scale evaluation projection reach the 120-minute mailbox threshold under a conservative fixed task2625 planning reserve?

source_projection_crosscheck.basis: task2621 source-bound training projection scaled to one of four rules; retain its full 1536-slot evaluation projection as conservative upper reference; add the 1200s reserve, 180s feasibility cap, and 36s task2625 audit-time reference.
source_projection_crosscheck.scope: Preliminary threshold only. Replace the full evaluation projection with a candidate-specific justified estimate and substitute actual root-preparation/audit/feasibility receipts before deciding on registration.
